findings.evidence: Lines 278–281 conclude equality with `(Submodule.span U {v}).restrictScalars ℚ`, while lines 290–293 require `Submodule.span U {v} = ⊤` to conclude span `= ⊤`.
findings.fix: Say no direction of the submodule generated by `v` is lost, and reserve the claim about all of `V` for cyclic modules.
findings.issue: The module docstring says fullness loses no direction of `V`, but `span_admissibleLattice` reaches only the cyclic submodule `U(L) • v`; it reaches all of `V` only under the cyclicity hypothesis of `span_admissibleLattice_eq_top`.

findings.evidence: `dividedPower_smul_mem_admissibleLattice` at lines 213–217 concerns one divided power, and lines 35–39 explicitly disclaim finite generation and integral freeness.
findings.fix: Describe only divided-power stability here, or explicitly qualify the exponential conclusion by local nilpotence and the additional freeness/basis hypotheses needed for matrices.
findings.issue: Lines 21–24 and 209–212 claim the root-vector exponentials act by integral matrices, but the file proves only that each divided power preserves an additive subgroup; it neither makes the infinite sum well-defined/locally finite nor supplies a free integral basis from which an integral matrix follows.

summary: The documentation overstates fullness and what divided-power stability establishes about exponentials.
